name: Storm Vest
body:
Price 12,000 gp; Aura faint evocation; CL 5; Weight 10 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

The trim of this vest is set with fine golden chain and the stitches appear to be arrayed as miniature bolts of lightning, it seems to hum lightly when worn. Twice per day while wearing the storm vest you can become a bolt of electricity as a standard action. You instantly move up to 60 feet in a straight line to an unoccupied space and deal 3d6 electric damage to each creature whose space you pass through, a reflex saving throw with a DC of 14 reduces this damage by half.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 6,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, lightning bolt
